cb45b8563fa711549c4f43fd64f697173bb43102.translation: 如何在电子表格中格式化数据，以实现有效的数据利用？

4c522a2ad6ee3345582fab95e0b628f513d9f277.source: What are basic principles for using spreadsheets for good data organization?
4c522a2ad6ee3345582fab95e0b628f513d9f277.translation: 使用电子表格进行良好数据组织的基本原则是什么？

87a17b35e553625e8a13f0ea9526274bfc4a78eb.source: Describe best practices for organizing data so computers can make the best use of datasets.
87a17b35e553625e8a13f0ea9526274bfc4a78eb.translation: 描述组织数据的最佳实践，以便计算机能够充分利用数据集。

ee6b55c00fc5e5ac5dbadccc27bacf1310738219.source: Good data organization is the foundation of any research project.
ee6b55c00fc5e5ac5dbadccc27bacf1310738219.translation: 良好的数据组织是任何研究项目的基石。

64ad795f7e890b9291fe3a447f7afa0aedd5dcec.source: Good data organization is the foundation of your research project. Most researchers have data or do data entry in spreadsheets. Spreadsheet programs are very useful graphical interfaces for designing data tables and handling very basic data quality control functions. See also <x0/>
64ad795f7e890b9291fe3a447f7afa0aedd5dcec.translation: 良好的数据组织是研究项目的基石。大多数研究人员使用电子表格存储数据或进行数据录入。电子表格软件是设计数据表和处理非常基础的数据质量控制功能的实用图形界面。另请参阅 <x0/>

5f906bed1cb36816ed4afb07c4c3a74f3e1200e2.source: Spreadsheets are good for data entry. Therefore we have a lot of data in spreadsheets.  Much of your time as a researcher will be spent in this 'data wrangling' stage.  It's not the most fun, but it's necessary. We'll teach you how to think about data organization and some practices for more effective data wrangling.
5f906bed1cb36816ed4afb07c4c3a74f3e1200e2.translation: 电子表格适合数据录入。因此，我们有大量数据存储在电子表格中。作为研究人员，你的大部分时间都将花在这个“数据整理”阶段。这虽然不算有趣，但却是必要的。我们将教你如何思考数据组织，并介绍一些更高效的数据整理实践。

5b949891dbc9e12f440045b7efb11188662ab5b5.source: What this lesson will not teach you
5b949891dbc9e12f440045b7efb11188662ab5b5.translation: 本课程不会教你的内容

8d7b30fe058607789040fef74a9e8d3faaf547e2.source: How to do *statistics* in a spreadsheet
8d7b30fe058607789040fef74a9e8d3faaf547e2.translation: 如何在电子表格中进行*统计*

ddc033f47e1ff39b77e48adf68bc6eaea1c271d5.source: How to do *plotting* in a spreadsheet
ddc033f47e1ff39b77e48adf68bc6eaea1c271d5.translation: 如何在电子表格中进行*绘图*

421d9bde47067fddfc27e7afbf2ec8e5ac5875e6.source: How to *write code* in spreadsheet programs
421d9bde47067fddfc27e7afbf2ec8e5ac5875e6.translation: 如何在电子表格程序中*编写代码*

92dd0125c2520b50af973f8679c02423dd4c369e.source: If you're looking to do this, a good reference is [Head First Excel](<x0/>), published by O'Reilly.
92dd0125c2520b50af973f8679c02423dd4c369e.translation: 如果您想这样做，O'Reilly 出版的 [Head First Excel](<x0/>) 是一本很好的参考书。

d80b7c879b388b57f4cbab18fb2e21eb8dd1169f.source: Why aren't we teaching data analysis in spreadsheets
d80b7c879b388b57f4cbab18fb2e21eb8dd1169f.translation: 为什么我们不教使用电子表格进行数据分析？

97d2793965454d8cce8ae7b28ffdfeba286f6ac3.source: Data analysis in spreadsheets usually requires a lot of manual work. If you want to change a parameter or run an analysis with a new dataset, you usually have to redo everything by hand. (We do know that you can create macros, but see the next point.)
97d2793965454d8cce8ae7b28ffdfeba286f6ac3.translation: 在电子表格中进行数据分析通常需要大量的手动操作。如果你想更改参数或使用新数据集运行分析，通常必须全部手动重新操作。（我们知道可以创建宏，但请参阅下一点。）

70bce8075b79dff5f6d1cebd3fe2cf9db1fb2958.source: It is also difficult to track or reproduce statistical or plotting analyses done in spreadsheet programs when you want to go back to your work or someone asks for details of your analysis.
70bce8075b79dff5f6d1cebd3fe2cf9db1fb2958.translation: 此外，当你想要回顾工作或有人询问分析详情时，也很难追踪或复现在电子表格软件中进行的统计或绘图分析。

c94e8972c88de075032e551aeaccde0e9c1bc5fd.source: Many spreadsheet programs are available. Since most participants utilise Excel as their primary spreadsheet program, this lesson will make use of Excel examples. A free spreadsheet program that can also be used is LibreOffice. Commands may differ a bit between programs, but the general idea is the same.
c94e8972c88de075032e551aeaccde0e9c1bc5fd.translation: 市面上有许多电子表格软件。由于大多数参与者将 Excel 作为主要的电子表格软件，本课程将采用 Excel 示例。另一款可使用的免费电子表格软件是 LibreOffice。不同软件之间的命令可能略有差异，但基本原理是一致的。

f3b0ba5cc19252f94a070ec7c151fd8c893c991c.source: Spreadsheet programs encompass a lot of the things we need to be able to do as researchers. We can use them for:
f3b0ba5cc19252f94a070ec7c151fd8c893c991c.translation: 电子表格软件涵盖了研究人员需要具备的许多能力。我们可以用它们来：

ae30b50bd1cdb84ae3cd4771556cb3b5706e817a.source: Spreadsheet programs use tables to represent and display data. Data formatted as tables is also the main theme of this chapter, and we will see how to organise data into tables in a standardised way to ensure efficient downstream analysis.
ae30b50bd1cdb84ae3cd4771556cb3b5706e817a.translation: 电子表格软件使用表格来表示和显示数据。以表格形式呈现的数据也是本章的主题，我们将学习如何以标准化的方式将数据组织成表格，以确保后续分析的高效性。

5ecd70d1802f0a0167cc449b0f4e110b2c308c67.source: Challenge: Discuss the following points with your neighbour
5ecd70d1802f0a0167cc449b0f4e110b2c308c67.translation: 挑战：与邻座讨论以下要点

e844fb3d8ff6e0c99acd98e32d47ccaaa701449a.source: Have you used spreadsheets, in your research, courses, or at home?
e844fb3d8ff6e0c99acd98e32d47ccaaa701449a.translation: 你在研究、课程或家中使用过电子表格吗？

076e604b6e743b40dcac87b03f89298ab4db8139.source: What kind of operations do you do in spreadsheets?
076e604b6e743b40dcac87b03f89298ab4db8139.translation: 你在电子表格中会进行什么样的操作？

65d2d861022498a63e9de16837b6e9be6e69bea0.source: Which ones do you think spreadsheets are good for?
65d2d861022498a63e9de16837b6e9be6e69bea0.translation: 你认为电子表格适用于哪些场景？

38d8308d3d916d50a62ce8caa332741d42c0d124.source: Have you accidentally done something in a spreadsheet program that made you frustrated or sad?
38d8308d3d916d50a62ce8caa332741d42c0d124.translation: 你是否曾在电子表格软件中不小心做了某些事情，从而感到沮丧或难过？

6ce02159573b452464cdcf1a1d9b87faa374a238.source: Spreadsheets are good for data entry, but in reality we tend to use spreadsheet programs for much more than data entry. We use them to create data tables for publications, to generate summary statistics, and make figures.
6ce02159573b452464cdcf1a1d9b87faa374a238.translation: 电子表格适用于数据录入，但实际上，我们使用电子表格软件的用途远不止于数据录入。我们用它们来创建用于发表的数据表，生成汇总统计数据，并制作图表。

480ee71b35253988231fc6b35550de5f9ec3a275.source: Generating tables for publications in a spreadsheet is not optimal - often, when formatting a data table for publication, we're reporting key summary statistics in a way that is not really meant to be read as data, and often involves special formatting (merging cells, creating borders, making it pretty). We advise you to do this sort of operation within your document editing software.
480ee71b35253988231fc6b35550de5f9ec3a275.translation: 在电子表格中生成发表用的表格并非最佳选择——通常在为发表进行数据表格格式化时，我们报告关键汇总统计数据的方式并非旨在作为数据阅读，且往往涉及特殊的格式设置（合并单元格、创建边框、美化排版）。我们建议您在文档编辑软件中完成此类操作。

cd59afeeec88f21c74a4e8e52a18a458668faeb4.source: The latter two applications, generating statistics and figures, should be used with caution: because of the graphical, drag and drop nature of spreadsheet programs, it can be very difficult, if not impossible, to replicate your steps (much less retrace anyone else's), particularly if your stats or figures require you to do more complex calculations. Furthermore, in doing calculations in a spreadsheet, it's easy to accidentally apply a slightly different formula to multiple adjacent cells. When using a command-line based statistics program like R or SAS, it's practically impossible to apply a calculation to one observation in your dataset but not another unless you're doing it on purpose.
cd59afeeec88f21c74a4e8e52a18a458668faeb4.translation: 后两项应用——生成统计数据和图表——应谨慎使用：由于电子表格程序具有图形化的拖放特性，复现你的操作步骤（更不用说还原他人的操作）可能非常困难，甚至是不可能的，尤其是当你的统计数据或图表需要进行更复杂的计算时。此外，在电子表格中进行计算时，很容易不小心对多个相邻单元格应用略有不同的公式。而使用像 R 或 SAS 这样基于命令行的统计程序时，除非是故意为之，否则几乎不可能对数据集中的某个观测值应用计算，而不对另一个观测值应用。

f4c2fab1cf3003707f2d0d512a76371a627d4197.source: Using spreadsheets for data entry and cleaning
f4c2fab1cf3003707f2d0d512a76371a627d4197.translation: 使用电子表格进行数据录入与清洗

8ce4b40ff7b2d5424cdd47c5e93c4a4e92fa14f8.source: In this lesson, we will assume that you are most likely using Excel as your primary spreadsheet program - there are others (gnumeric, Calc from OpenOffice), and their functionality is similar, but Excel seems to be the program most used by biologists and biomedical researchers.
8ce4b40ff7b2d5424cdd47c5e93c4a4e92fa14f8.translation: 在本节课中，我们假设您最可能使用 Excel 作为主要的电子表格程序——虽然还有其他程序（gnumeric、OpenOffice 的 Calc），且其功能相似，但 Excel 似乎是生物学家和生物医学研究人员最常用的程序。

5b3ff5a68f907a5b58229cb904596f74ecad25bf.source: In this lesson we're going to talk about:
5b3ff5a68f907a5b58229cb904596f74ecad25bf.translation: 在本节课中，我们将讲解：

d6c3c5da4cced3d6f752ef073d8a8ca6a7d083ee.translation: 在电子表格中格式化数据表

7a1e44a990e69872b25b76906a2d1cb36fd4b7b5.source: Describe best practices for data entry and formatting in spreadsheets.
7a1e44a990e69872b25b76906a2d1cb36fd4b7b5.translation: 描述电子表格中数据输入和格式化的最佳实践。

2cbd93cd779426c87371d91a8e5d85ce85ee813f.source: Apply best practices to arrange variables and observations in a spreadsheet.
2cbd93cd779426c87371d91a8e5d85ce85ee813f.translation: 采用最佳实践在电子表格中排列变量和观测值。

3b6e2c41679004a1ff10dd12b0ab9d08af0dc984.source: Never modify your raw data. Always make a copy before making any changes.
3b6e2c41679004a1ff10dd12b0ab9d08af0dc984.translation: 绝不要修改原始数据。在进行任何更改之前，务必先创建副本。

3d11cc6f8e4374982f40982b5c60c39f94ecc856.source: Keep track of all of the steps you take to clean your data in a plain text file.
3d11cc6f8e4374982f40982b5c60c39f94ecc856.translation: 在纯文本文件中记录清洗数据的所有步骤。

25177c88854934029a4deec589c45875383bad61.source: The most common mistake made is treating spreadsheet programs like lab notebooks, that is, relying on context, notes in the margin, spatial layout of data and fields to convey information. As humans, we can (usually) interpret these things, but computers don't view information the same way, and unless we explain to the computer what every single thing means (and that can be hard!), it will not be able to see how our data fits together.
25177c88854934029a4deec589c45875383bad61.translation: 最常见的错误是将电子表格软件当作实验笔记本来使用，也就是说，依赖上下文、页边注释、数据和字段的空间布局来传递信息。作为人类，我们（通常）能够解读这些内容，但计算机并非如此看待信息，除非我们向计算机解释每一个细节的含义（而这可能很困难！），否则它将无法理解我们的数据是如何关联在一起的。

405871815c4bd873dd0f2e7acba93fd9825a93a5.source: Using the power of computers, we can manage and analyse data in much more effective and faster ways, but to use that power, we have to set up our data for the computer to be able to understand it (and computers are very literal).
405871815c4bd873dd0f2e7acba93fd9825a93a5.translation: 借助计算机的力量，我们可以以更高效、更快速的方式管理和分析数据，但要发挥这种力量，我们必须对数据进行准备，使计算机能够理解它们（而计算机非常严格）。

916562afd646f54c1f71bdbdc46b3e002b0b5551.source: This is why it's extremely important to set up well-formatted tables from the outset - before you even start entering data from your very first preliminary experiment. Data organization is the foundation of your research project. It can make it easier or harder to work with your data throughout your analysis, so it's worth thinking about when you're doing your data entry or setting up your experiment. You can set things up in different ways in spreadsheets, but some of these choices can limit your ability to work with the data in other programs or have the you-of-6-months-from-now or your collaborator work with the data.
916562afd646f54c1f71bdbdc46b3e002b0b5551.translation: 这就是为什么从一开始就建立格式规范的表格至关重要——甚至在你开始输入第一次初步实验的数据之前就应该这样做。数据组织是研究项目的基石。它会影响你在整个分析过程中处理数据的难易程度，因此在进行数据录入或设置实验时，值得仔细考虑。在电子表格中，你可以采用不同的设置方式，但其中一些选择可能会限制你在其他程序中处理数据的能力，或者影响你 6 个月后的自己或你的合作者处理数据的便捷程度。

f6c0869c17f4f4f3a43941a5649978d5c14e83e7.source: **Note:** the best layouts/formats (as well as software and interfaces) for data entry and data analysis might be different. It is important to take this into account, and ideally automate the conversion from one to another.
f6c0869c17f4f4f3a43941a5649978d5c14e83e7.translation: **注意：** 数据录入和数据分析的最佳布局/格式（以及软件和界面）可能各不相同。考虑到这一点至关重要，理想情况下应将两者之间的转换自动化。

ef3b1ffffdadbebca7cd410a1897c8f43eb3e12d.source: When you're working with spreadsheets, during data clean up or analyses, it's very easy to end up with a spreadsheet that looks very different from the one you started with. In order to be able to reproduce your analyses or figure out what you did when a reviewer or instructor asks for a different analysis, you should
ef3b1ffffdadbebca7cd410a1897c8f43eb3e12d.translation: 在使用电子表格进行数据清洗或分析时，很容易导致最终的表格与初始表格看起来大相径庭。为了能够复现您的分析结果，或在审稿人或导师要求进行不同分析时查明您具体做了什么，您应当

f9622c4d9a9b4a47041f27807b57562d5b1f57f5.source: create a new file with your cleaned or analysed data. Don't modify the original dataset, or you will never know where you started!
f9622c4d9a9b4a47041f27807b57562d5b1f57f5.translation: 创建一个包含清洗或分析后数据的新文件。不要修改原始数据集，否则你永远不知道最初的状态！

908f404de81139f07440207e6ea42a9dfdccd06b.source: keep track of the steps you took in your clean up or analysis. You should track these steps as you would any step in an experiment. We recommend that you do this in a plain text file stored in the same folder as the data file.
908f404de81139f07440207e6ea42a9dfdccd06b.translation: 记录您在清洗或分析过程中采取的步骤。您应当像记录实验中的任何步骤一样记录这些步骤。我们建议您将这些步骤记录在与数据文件位于同一文件夹的纯文本文件中。

67110c4b30bb9c763392441a4d6cf2ecf6dea52b.source: This might be an example of a spreadsheet setup:
67110c4b30bb9c763392441a4d6cf2ecf6dea52b.translation: 这可能是一个电子表格设置示例：

235d28ba8ca2015de136015b71729d8626c34804.source: Put these principles into practice today during your exercises.
235d28ba8ca2015de136015b71729d8626c34804.translation: 在今天的练习中，请将这些原则付诸实践。

d67394364e54a2b1812ebab7245d1b7dc24dfff2.source: While versioning is out of scope for this course, you can look at the Carpentries lesson on ['Git'](<x0/>) to learn how to maintain **version control** over your data. See also this [blog post](<x1/>) for a quick tutorial or <x2/> for a more research-oriented use-case.
d67394364e54a2b1812ebab7245d1b7dc24dfff2.translation: 虽然版本控制超出了本课程的范围，但您可以参考 Carpentries 关于 ['Git'](<x0/>) 的课程，学习如何对数据进行**版本控制**。此外，您还可以参阅这篇 [博文](<x1/>) 了解快速入门教程，或参阅 <x2/> 以了解更面向研究的使用场景。

82c5f788eb7d0da52efe6ccc890f610cf4ad1943.translation: 电子表格中的数据结构

868e94b637e5d5d34b7373930886fa33c5243914.source: The cardinal rules of using spreadsheet programs for data:
868e94b637e5d5d34b7373930886fa33c5243914.translation: 使用电子表格软件处理数据的基本原则：

7ac844d690a5e4141caf55f880ed66149c74ab9e.source: Put all your variables in columns - the thing you're measuring, like 'weight' or 'temperature'.
7ac844d690a5e4141caf55f880ed66149c74ab9e.translation: 将所有变量放在列中 —— 即你要测量的项目，例如“重量”或“温度”。

9326c5a158e30c7baac16d4f1aea6598989a9b31.source: Put each observation in its own row.
9326c5a158e30c7baac16d4f1aea6598989a9b31.translation: 将每条观测值放在独立的行中。

89bd06bb5912d27792310693f38939dc645e7b02.source: Don't combine multiple pieces of information in one cell. Sometimes it just seems like one thing, but think if that's the only way you'll want to be able to use or sort that data.
89bd06bb5912d27792310693f38939dc645e7b02.translation: 不要将多项信息合并在同一个单元格中。虽然有时看起来像是一件事，但请思考一下，如果只能通过这种方式来使用或排序这些数据，是否真的可行。

77b2ee6626e1b7db8ab74c3b9eb936ecc2122889.source: Leave the raw data raw - don't change it!
77b2ee6626e1b7db8ab74c3b9eb936ecc2122889.translation: 保持原始数据原样 —— 不要对其进行修改！

77ba47e01b636c5d3663ab109a448a87c06e6a84.source: Export the cleaned data to a text-based format like CSV (comma-separated values) format. This ensures that anyone can use the data, and is required by most data repositories.
77ba47e01b636c5d3663ab109a448a87c06e6a84.translation: 将清洗后的数据导出为文本格式，例如 CSV（逗号分隔值）格式。这能确保任何人都能使用这些数据，且大多数数据存储库都对此有要求。

dde4e8c1200a17f2b177035ad9a4beeabcdc7718.source: For instance, we have data from patients that visited several hospitals in Brussels, Belgium. They recorded the date of the visit, the hospital, the patients' gender, weight and blood group.
dde4e8c1200a17f2b177035ad9a4beeabcdc7718.translation: 例如，我们有一组来自比利时布鲁塞尔多家医院就诊的患者数据。他们记录了就诊日期、医院、患者的性别、体重和血型。

5ed20234d39627f707391f008e930ddedd4930e5.source: If we were to keep track of the data like this:
5ed20234d39627f707391f008e930ddedd4930e5.translation: 如果我们这样记录数据：

47e005afb75fdabfe57a7a6ff85d416dd78c486f.source: the problem is that the ABO and Rhesus groups are in the same <x0/> type column. So, if they wanted to look at all observations of the A group or look at weight distributions by ABO group, it would be tricky to do this using this data setup. If instead we put the ABO and Rhesus groups in different columns, you can see that it would be much easier.
47e005afb75fdabfe57a7a6ff85d416dd78c486f.translation: 问题在于 ABO 和 Rhesus 组位于同一个 <x0/> 类型列中。因此，如果他们想查看 A 组的所有观测值，或者按 ABO 组查看体重分布，使用这种数据设置会很棘手。如果我们将 ABO 和 Rhesus 组分在不同的列中，你就会发现这样会容易得多。

a36ce99223abf7b1af8b6dc115e8b0d8d9a641c5.source: An important rule when setting up a datasheet, is that **columns are used for variables** and **rows are used for observations**:
a36ce99223abf7b1af8b6dc115e8b0d8d9a641c5.translation: 在建立数据表时，一项重要规则是：**列用于变量**，而**行用于观测值**：

1151afa9d19afd6257c2fe6b7c1e116079e350f7.source: Challenge: We're going to take a messy dataset and describe how we would clean it up.
1151afa9d19afd6257c2fe6b7c1e116079e350f7.translation: 挑战：我们将处理一个杂乱的数据集，并描述如何对其进行清洗。

87a938dd66d17dcf3d3931e9da26345d7aecca7d.source: Download a messy dataset by [clicking this link](<x0/>).
87a938dd66d17dcf3d3931e9da26345d7aecca7d.translation: [点击此链接](<x0/>)下载一个杂乱的数据集。

7b3b6033f2cebaa50d4c1cb3e59492d2bca91e7a.source: Open up the data in a spreadsheet program.
7b3b6033f2cebaa50d4c1cb3e59492d2bca91e7a.translation: 在电子表格软件中打开数据。

87588f3f761dc00a87dd8002a055c68f4e776a59.source: You can see that there are two tabs. The data contains various clinical variables recorded in various hospitals in Brussels during the first and second COVID-19 waves in 2020. As you can see, the data have been recorded differently during the March and November waves. Now you're the person in charge of this project and you want to be able to start analyzing the data.
87588f3f761dc00a87dd8002a055c68f4e776a59.translation: 你可以看到这里有两个选项卡。数据包含 2020 年第一波和第二波 COVID-19 期间，在布鲁塞尔各家医院记录的各种临床变量。如你所见，3 月和 11 月两波期间的数据记录方式有所不同。现在你是该项目的负责人，希望能够开始分析这些数据。

96992cefb71b0189e5d3b693dc12d05f67739015.source: With the person next to you, identify what is wrong with this spreadsheet. Also discuss the steps you would need to take to clean up first and second wave tabs, and to put them all together in one spreadsheet.
96992cefb71b0189e5d3b693dc12d05f67739015.translation: 与身旁的人一起，找出这份电子表格有哪些问题。同时讨论清理第一波和第二波标签页，并将它们整合到一个电子表格中的具体步骤。

d362067aa00ce8a7d3470af56254d0807611b2c0.source: **Important:** Do not forget our first piece of advice: to create a new file (or tab) for the cleaned data, never modify your original (raw) data.
d362067aa00ce8a7d3470af56254d0807611b2c0.translation: **重要提示：** 请不要忘记我们的第一条建议：为清洗后的数据创建新文件（或新标签页），绝不要修改原始（原始）数据。

5206627f61e60236749a738f5336dd37f47887e4.source: After you go through this exercise, we'll discuss as a group what was wrong with this data and how you would fix it.
5206627f61e60236749a738f5336dd37f47887e4.translation: 完成这项练习后，我们将小组讨论这组数据出了什么问题，以及你们将如何修复它。

d007c9f47ea3173cbab483f54d88a230beb26569.source: Challenge: Once you have tidied up the data, answer the following questions:
d007c9f47ea3173cbab483f54d88a230beb26569.translation: 挑战：在清理好数据后，请回答以下问题：

923c09e98c09258907c109cd80b4d543bcad286e.source: How many men and women took part in the study?
923c09e98c09258907c109cd80b4d543bcad286e.translation: 共有多少名男性和女性参与了这项研究？

cbf25bdd41ff3b45d6a36135dad2890362cb6b2d.source: How many A, AB, and B types have been tested?
cbf25bdd41ff3b45d6a36135dad2890362cb6b2d.translation: 已测试多少个 A、AB 和 B 型？

28e26b75d940150fa1ef310b104e55d702a00aaa.source: As above, but disregarding the contaminated samples?
28e26b75d940150fa1ef310b104e55d702a00aaa.translation: 同上，但忽略被污染的样本？

2d45e851b22532e4c93c3a5a13d02e936a68f9af.source: How many Rhesus + and - have been tested?
2d45e851b22532e4c93c3a5a13d02e936a68f9af.translation: 已检测多少例 Rhesus + 和 -？

d4596a2c326fd6cb5771b2670536fe3e99469964.source: How many universal donors (O-) have been tested?
d4596a2c326fd6cb5771b2670536fe3e99469964.translation: 已测试多少名通用供血者 (O-)？

8ed2153877ba7ae96e74b86758a0b247791525cb.source: What is the average weight of AB men?
8ed2153877ba7ae96e74b86758a0b247791525cb.translation: AB型男性的平均体重是多少？

cb1c77f51aedbf6810cac385fbace18763ef22e4.source: How many samples have been tested in the different hospitals?
cb1c77f51aedbf6810cac385fbace18763ef22e4.translation: 各家医院分别检测了多少个样本？

21eae40b9564472afd87f6ba3f27a2514674431b.source: An **excellent reference**, in particular with regard to R scripting is the *Tidy Data* paper <x0/>
21eae40b9564472afd87f6ba3f27a2514674431b.translation: 一份**极佳的参考资料**，尤其是关于 R 脚本编写方面的，是 *Tidy Data* 论文 <x0/>

98beaf5ea3668e72c1f4ba795d7b9d0bb19fe08f.source: What are some common challenges with formatting data in spreadsheets and how can we avoid them?
98beaf5ea3668e72c1f4ba795d7b9d0bb19fe08f.translation: 在电子表格中格式化数据时常见的挑战有哪些，又该如何避免？

992c2357b701b5ff426a61ad42f477442422a9e6.source: Recognise and resolve common spreadsheet formatting problems.
992c2357b701b5ff426a61ad42f477442422a9e6.translation: 识别并解决常见的电子表格格式问题。

3342d12962915c9ef6b1d560467ebf852ce8769f.source: Avoid using multiple tables within one spreadsheet.
3342d12962915c9ef6b1d560467ebf852ce8769f.translation: 避免在单个电子表格中使用多个表格。

ef89b582ee9a7f81e06cf3b849d3c952e93fb606.source: Avoid spreading data across multiple tabs.
ef89b582ee9a7f81e06cf3b849d3c952e93fb606.translation: 避免将数据分散在多个选项卡中。

37087abc5ea4f3e962b6d78b11c25e76fd84fb6c.source: Use an appropriate null value to record missing data.
37087abc5ea4f3e962b6d78b11c25e76fd84fb6c.translation: 使用适当的空值来记录缺失数据。

f7da4ff85717e722340d9bc69aeaa605836d4dca.source: Don't use formatting to convey information or to make your spreadsheet look pretty.
f7da4ff85717e722340d9bc69aeaa605836d4dca.translation: 不要使用格式来传递信息或美化电子表格的外观。

d658f995659cf076244f73999b018c6b9279e978.source: Place comments in a separate column.
d658f995659cf076244f73999b018c6b9279e978.translation: 将注释放在单独的列中。

68c256380c00d5e9ade77b4c5ce4061e711aaf10.source: Include only one piece of information in a cell.
68c256380c00d5e9ade77b4c5ce4061e711aaf10.translation: 每个单元格仅包含一项信息。

97b383f73fb85ef25db187871891d4283c8b6b0a.source: Avoid spaces, numbers and special characters in column headers.
97b383f73fb85ef25db187871891d4283c8b6b0a.translation: 避免在列标题中使用空格、数字和特殊字符。

0c82be73e980e74509fff28cf5886ca3aaabe411.source: Avoid special characters in your data.
0c82be73e980e74509fff28cf5886ca3aaabe411.translation: 请避免在数据中使用特殊字符。

8f590d60c29e3aee45523ae38a0d7f64c9c54f4b.source: Record metadata in a separate plain text file.
8f590d60c29e3aee45523ae38a0d7f64c9c54f4b.translation: 将元数据记录在单独的纯文本文件中。

76701aa39ffc3cbb0f89b00b178c49ea3138d039.source: There are a few potential errors to be on the lookout for in your own data as well as data from collaborators or the Internet. If you are aware of the errors and the possible negative effect on downstream data analysis and result interpretation, it might motivate yourself and your project members to try and avoid them. Making small changes to the way you format your data in spreadsheets, can have a great impact on efficiency and reliability when it comes to data cleaning and analysis.
76701aa39ffc3cbb0f89b00b178c49ea3138d039.translation: 无论是您自己的数据，还是来自合作者或互联网的数据，都可能存在一些需要留意的潜在错误。如果您了解这些错误，以及它们可能对后续数据分析和结果解读产生的负面影响，这可能会激励您和项目成员努力避免这些错误。对电子表格中数据格式的处理方式进行微调，对于数据清洗和分析的效率与可靠性将产生重大影响。

af48155ba4f685b3cf11b7b980f0c973e93973a1.source: [Using formatting to make the data sheet look pretty](<x0/>)

ff55cf991e43210a020a717cfca95a11eda788d6.translation: [在单元格中放置注释或单位](<x0/>)

ca58bf91e13688945b06df39e00cba4a3240d950.source: [Entering more than one piece of information in a cell](<x0/>)

3ece8fd129d9c6c4c2a3fe490bdf463f1271d84a.source: A common strategy is creating multiple data tables within one spreadsheet. This confuses the computer, so don't do this!  When you create multiple tables within one spreadsheet, you're drawing false associations between things for the computer, which sees each row as an observation. You're also potentially using the same field name in multiple places, which will make it harder to clean your data up into a usable form. The example below depicts the problem:
3ece8fd129d9c6c4c2a3fe490bdf463f1271d84a.translation: 一种常见的做法是在一个电子表格中创建多个数据表。这会让计算机产生混淆，所以千万不要这样做！当你在一个电子表格中创建多个表时，你是在为计算机建立错误的关联，因为计算机将每一行视为一次观测。此外，你可能会在多个地方使用相同的字段名，这将使数据更难以清理成可用的形式。下面的示例说明了这个问题：

359426d50c414ee5fc2f12bdfd7941fa8e71ce5b.source: In the example above, the computer will see (for example) row 4 and assume that all columns A-AF refer to the same sample. This row actually represents four distinct samples (sample 1 for each of four different collection dates - May 29th, June 12th, June 19th, and June 26th), as well as some calculated summary statistics (an average (avr) and standard error of measurement (SEM)) for two of those samples. Other rows are similarly problematic.
359426d50c414ee5fc2f12bdfd7941fa8e71ce5b.translation: 在上述示例中，计算机会看到（例如）第 4 行，并假设所有 A-AF 列都指代同一个样本。实际上，这一行代表了四个不同的样本（四个不同采集日期——5 月 29 日、6 月 12 日、6 月 19 日和 6 月 26 日——每天一个样本 1），以及其中两个样本的一些计算得出的汇总统计数据（平均值 (avr) 和测量标准误 (SEM)）。其他行同样存在问题。

81083ce0fe58f43b39a419f456f2cddd8020cae7.source: But what about workbook tabs? That seems like an easy way to organise data, right? Well, yes and no. When you create extra tabs, you fail to allow the computer to see connections in the data that are there (you have to introduce spreadsheet application-specific functions or scripting to ensure this connection). Say, for instance, you make a separate tab for each day you take a measurement.
81083ce0fe58f43b39a419f456f2cddd8020cae7.translation: 但工作簿标签页呢？这看起来是组织数据的一种简单方法，对吧？嗯，是也不是。当你创建额外的标签页时，你就没能让计算机识别出数据中已有的关联（你必须引入电子表格应用程序特有的函数或脚本来确保这种关联）。举个例子，假设你为每次测量的日期分别创建了一个标签页。

91b6ced5906ee7b52053f6f2eca6da3ff701b8c3.source: This isn't good practice for two reasons:
91b6ced5906ee7b52053f6f2eca6da3ff701b8c3.translation: 这样做不妥，原因有两点：

cb2d01bf4df1a70ac75754b5ae24bb8196fc93d9.source: you are more likely to accidentally add inconsistencies to your data if each time you take a measurement, you start recording data in a new tab, and
cb2d01bf4df1a70ac75754b5ae24bb8196fc93d9.translation: 如果你每次进行测量时都开始在新标签页中记录数据，那么你更容易在数据中不小心引入不一致之处，而且

fff3531c5bb4536f386d286d8df2ff12a595883f.source: even if you manage to prevent all inconsistencies from creeping in, you will add an extra step for yourself before you analyse the data because you will have to combine these data into a single datatable. You will have to explicitly tell the computer how to combine tabs - and if the tabs are inconsistently formatted, you might even have to do it manually.
fff3531c5bb4536f386d286d8df2ff12a595883f.translation: 即便你能够防止所有不一致之处的混入，在分析数据之前，你仍需增加一个额外步骤，因为你必须将这些数据合并为一个单一的数据表。你必须明确告知计算机如何合并这些标签页——而且如果标签页的格式不统一，你甚至可能需要手动操作。

7c33c80be79f67020cb754447a35f93b859831f9.source: The next time you're entering data, and you go to create another tab or table, ask yourself if you could avoid adding this tab by adding another column to your original spreadsheet. We used multiple tabs in our example of a messy data file, but now you've seen how you can reorganise your data to consolidate across tabs.
7c33c80be79f67020cb754447a35f93b859831f9.translation: 下次输入数据时，如果你打算创建另一个标签页或表格，请问问自己是否可以通过在原电子表格中添加另一列来避免创建这个标签页。在我们的杂乱数据文件示例中，我们使用了多个标签页，但现在你已经看到了如何重新组织数据以跨标签页进行整合。

e23407ddd7c8a8d38da386c7ef12509a69aa21d3.source: Your data sheet might get very long over the course of the experiment. This makes it harder to enter data if you can't see your headers at the top of the spreadsheet. But don't repeat your header row. These can easily get mixed into the data, leading to problems down the road. Instead you can [freeze the column headers](<x0/>) so that they remain visible even when you have a spreadsheet with many rows.
e23407ddd7c8a8d38da386c7ef12509a69aa21d3.translation: 在实验过程中，您的数据表可能会变得非常长。如果您无法在电子表格顶部看到表头，就更难输入数据。但请不要重复表头行。表头行很容易与数据混淆，从而在日后引发问题。相反，您可以[冻结列标题](<x0/>)，这样即使电子表格行数很多，它们依然可见。

f94f8ec8cf7ce29449d14780068e0db675aa4361.source: It might be that when you're measuring something, it's usually a zero, say the number of times a rabbit is observed in the survey. Why bother writing in the number zero in that column, when it's mostly zeros?
f94f8ec8cf7ce29449d14780068e0db675aa4361.translation: 也许在测量某项指标时，结果通常是零，比如调查中观察到兔子的次数。既然该列大部分都是零，为什么还要特意在其中写上数字零呢？

ec2dbf0849c31c62ed39d4dc83f629a80483bd04.source: However, there's a difference between a zero and a blank cell in a spreadsheet. To the computer, a zero is actually data. You measured or counted it. A blank cell means that it wasn't measured and the computer will interpret it as an unknown value (also known as a null or missing value).
ec2dbf0849c31c62ed39d4dc83f629a80483bd04.translation: 然而，电子表格中的零与空白单元格有所不同。对于计算机而言，零实际上是数据。你测量或计数了它。空白单元格则意味着该项未被测量，计算机会将其解释为未知值（也称为 null 值或缺失值）。

d12cc3efebf05130c726d091a2fda4b6beb1306c.source: The spreadsheets or statistical programs will likely misinterpret blank cells that you intend to be zeros. By not entering the value of your observation, you are telling your computer to represent that data as unknown or missing (null). This can cause problems with subsequent calculations or analyses. For example, the average of a set of numbers which includes a single null value is always null (because the computer can't guess the value of the missing observations). Because of this, it's very important to record zeros as zeros and truly missing data as nulls.
d12cc3efebf05130c726d091a2fda4b6beb1306c.translation: 电子表格或统计软件很可能会误读你打算作为零的空白单元格。通过不输入观测值，你实际上是在告诉计算机将该数据表示为未知或缺失（null）。这可能会导致后续计算或分析出现问题。例如，包含一个 null 值的一组数字的平均值始终为 null（因为计算机无法推断缺失观测值的数值）。因此，将零记录为零，而将真正的缺失数据记录为 null 至关重要。

c89da90fdc1477e8b15c12b38f8330388ac254c0.source: **Example**: using -999 or other numerical values (or zero) to represent missing data.
c89da90fdc1477e8b15c12b38f8330388ac254c0.translation: **示例**：使用 -999 或其他数值（或零）来表示缺失数据。

006c4e180bb29345d2d03e86e58a5900ddb6491e.source: There are a few reasons why null values get represented differently within a dataset. Sometimes confusing null values are automatically recorded from the measuring device. If that's the case, there's not much you can do, but it can be addressed in data cleaning with a tool like [OpenRefine](<x0/>) before analysis. Other times different null values are used to convey different reasons why the data isn't there. This is important information to capture, but is in effect using one column to capture two pieces of information. Like for [using formatting to convey information](<x1/>) it would be good here to create a new column like '<x2/>' and use that column to capture the different reasons.
006c4e180bb29345d2d03e86e58a5900ddb6491e.translation: 在数据集中，空值的表示方式有所不同，原因有几种。有时，测量设备会自动记录令人困惑的空值。如果是这种情况，你几乎无能为力，但可以在分析前使用 [OpenRefine](<x0/>) 等工具进行数据清洗来解决。另一种情况是，使用不同的空值来表示数据缺失的不同原因。这是需要记录的重要信息，但实际上相当于用一个列来记录两项信息。就像 [使用格式传递信息](<x1/>) 一样，在这种情况下，最好创建一个名为 '<x2/>' 的新列，并使用该列来记录不同的原因。

0269707d479d491e005ac0814136e464b7a62857.source: Whatever the reason, it's a problem if unknown or missing data is recorded as -999, 999, or 0.
0269707d479d491e005ac0814136e464b7a62857.translation: 无论原因如何，如果未知或缺失的数据被记录为 -999、999 或 0，就会产生问题。

13f988e369abda658c98b4baf9e5d5eb6c9921cc.source: Many statistical programs will not recognise that these are intended to represent missing (null) values. How these values are interpreted will depend on the software you use to analyse your data. It is essential to use a clearly defined and consistent null indicator.
13f988e369abda658c98b4baf9e5d5eb6c9921cc.translation: 许多统计软件无法识别这些值旨在表示缺失（null）值。这些值如何被解释，取决于您用于分析数据的软件。使用一个定义明确且一致的 null 标识符至关重要。

4eb9257762fa9903abfd9cf6a9e960f2d907ace4.source: Blanks (most applications) and NA (for R) are good choices. <x0/> explain good choices for indicating null values for different software applications in their article:
4eb9257762fa9903abfd9cf6a9e960f2d907ace4.translation: 空白单元格（适用于大多数应用程序）和 NA（适用于 R）都是不错的选择。<x0/> 在其文章中介绍了不同软件中表示空值的合适方式：

8778e057dbb678ba5b897406503a4cef635203f6.source: **Example**: highlighting cells, rows or columns that should be excluded from an analysis, leaving blank rows to indicate separations in data.
8778e057dbb678ba5b897406503a4cef635203f6.translation: **示例**：高亮显示应从分析中剔除的单元格、行或列，并留出空白行以表示数据的分隔。

06b2c1c6caf6157ac8dbab40a9129f773d784198.source: **Solution**: create a new field to encode which data should be excluded.
06b2c1c6caf6157ac8dbab40a9129f773d784198.translation: **解决方案**：创建一个新字段来编码哪些数据应被排除。

79520831f2013a2ee3ce7abdef1ee2dd35bf4bb6.source: Using formatting to make the data sheet look pretty <x0/>
79520831f2013a2ee3ce7abdef1ee2dd35bf4bb6.translation: 使用格式化使数据表看起来美观 <x0/>

5e0aaf79ce18d8ec87b56dc3e81aba2994fac966.source: **Solution**: If you're not careful, formatting a worksheet to be more aesthetically pleasing can compromise your computer's ability to see associations in the data. Merged cells will make your data unreadable by statistics software. Consider restructuring your data in such a way that you will not need to merge cells to organise your data.
5e0aaf79ce18d8ec87b56dc3e81aba2994fac966.translation: **解决方案**：如果不小心，为了美观而对工作表进行格式化，可能会影响计算机识别数据中关联的能力。合并单元格会导致统计软件无法读取您的数据。请考虑重新构建数据结构，以便在组织数据时无需合并单元格。

5f5e27d8605e903e8a9623ff65578ba12a720d47.source: Placing comments or units in cells <x0/>
5f5e27d8605e903e8a9623ff65578ba12a720d47.translation: 在单元格中放置注释或单位 <x0/>

23b7552f17d9642dfe1434c82a49ec6d0c910f36.source: Most analysis software can't see Excel or LibreOffice comments, and would be confused by comments placed within your data cells. As described above for formatting, create another field if you need to add notes to cells. Similarly, don't include units in cells: ideally, all the measurements you place in one column should be in the same unit, but if for some reason they aren't, create another field and specify the units the cell is in.
23b7552f17d9642dfe1434c82a49ec6d0c910f36.translation: 大多数分析软件无法识别 Excel 或 LibreOffice 的注释，且会对数据单元格中放置的注释产生混淆。如上文在格式化部分所述，如果您需要在单元格中添加备注，请创建另一个字段。同样，请勿在单元格中包含单位：理想情况下，您在同一列中放置的所有测量值应使用相同的单位；但如果出于某种原因并非如此，请创建另一个字段并指定该单元格所使用的单位。

29f30e56f1abcf110a6176b5725851b55200d312.source: Entering more than one piece of information in a cell <x0/>
29f30e56f1abcf110a6176b5725851b55200d312.translation: 在单元格中输入多项信息 <x0/>

0631467c08011e191d45c443974f063dc36663be.source: **Example**: Recording ABO and Rhesus groups in one cell, such as A+, B+, A-, ...
0631467c08011e191d45c443974f063dc36663be.translation: **示例**：在同一个单元格中记录 ABO 和 Rhesus 组，例如 A+, B+, A-, ...

e467151f771950b928beaa21e6a034934b72c916.source: **Solution**: Don't include more than one piece of information in a cell. This will limit the ways in which you can analyse your data.  If you need both these measurements, design your data sheet to include this information. For example, include one column for the ABO group and one for the Rhesus group.
e467151f771950b928beaa21e6a034934b72c916.translation: **解决方案**：不要在一个单元格中存储多条信息。这将限制您分析数据的方式。如果您需要这两项测量值，请在数据表中设计相应的布局以包含这些信息。例如，分别设置一列用于 ABO 组，另一列用于 Rhesus 组。

2837028fe9ca7cc3917473ba4724a863e6534265.source: Choose descriptive field names, but be careful not to include spaces, numbers, or special characters of any kind. Spaces can be misinterpreted by parsers that use whitespace as delimiters and some programs don't like field names that are text strings that start with numbers.
2837028fe9ca7cc3917473ba4724a863e6534265.translation: 请选择具有描述性的字段名称，但要注意不要包含空格、数字或任何类型的特殊字符。空格可能会被将空白字符作为分隔符的解析器误读，且某些程序不支持以数字开头的文本字符串作为字段名称。

d73baaca52289bc0550021d07a737f4970f87ec2.source: Underscores (<x0/>) are a good alternative to spaces. Consider writing names in camel case (like this: ExampleFileName) to improve readability. Remember that abbreviations that make sense at the moment may not be so obvious in 6 months, but don't overdo it with names that are excessively long. Including the units in the field names avoids confusion and enables others to readily interpret your fields.
d73baaca52289bc0550021d07a737f4970f87ec2.translation: 下划线 (<x0/>) 是空格的良好替代方案。考虑使用驼峰命名法（例如：ExampleFileName）以提高可读性。请记住，目前有意义的缩写在 6 个月后可能不再显而易见，但不要将名称写得过长。在字段名称中包含单位可避免混淆，并使他人能够轻松理解您的字段。

c77f372cc0561f742a84e26af5147af2057af5c0.translation: 在数据中使用特殊字符 <x0/>

d41ac25555dd4360f324b7443f480ca14776987b.source: **Example**: You treat your spreadsheet program as a word processor when writing notes, for example copying data directly from Word or other applications.
d41ac25555dd4360f324b7443f480ca14776987b.translation: **示例**：在撰写笔记时，你将电子表格软件视为文字处理软件，例如直接从 Word 或其他应用程序中复制数据。

53f522692d18df5357ecfe7d047a3450929e7977.source: **Solution**: This is a common strategy. For example, when writing longer text in a cell, people often include line breaks, em-dashes, etc. in their spreadsheet. Also, when copying data in from applications such as Word, formatting and fancy non-standard characters (such as left- and right-aligned quotation marks) are included. When exporting this data into a coding/statistical environment or into a relational database, dangerous things may occur, such as lines being cut in half and encoding errors being thrown.
53f522692d18df5357ecfe7d047a3450929e7977.translation: **解决方案**：这是一种常见的做法。例如，在单元格中编写较长文本时，人们经常在电子表格中加入换行符、长破折号等。此外，在从 Word 等应用程序复制数据时，格式和特殊的非标准字符（如左对齐和右对齐的引号）也会被包含在内。在将这些数据导出到编程/统计环境或关系型数据库时，可能会出现危险情况，例如行被截断以及抛出编码错误。

68ed899714c5d17d74f1ed3b973e09fba4bfef31.source: General best practice is to avoid adding characters such as newlines, tabs, and vertical tabs. In other words, treat a text cell as if it were a simple web form that can only contain text and spaces.
68ed899714c5d17d74f1ed3b973e09fba4bfef31.translation: 通用最佳实践是避免添加换行符、制表符和垂直制表符等字符。换句话说，将文本单元格视为一个只能包含文本和空格的简单 Web 表单。

a1967b420efcf4f7912ba5a25958c5e8537a95df.source: Inclusion of metadata in data table <x0/>
a1967b420efcf4f7912ba5a25958c5e8537a95df.translation: 在数据表中包含元数据 <x0/>

61662d26c8998eb812e3fc518cb7bdd63ee0384e.source: **Example**: You add a legend at the top or bottom of your data table explaining column meaning, units, exceptions, etc.
61662d26c8998eb812e3fc518cb7bdd63ee0384e.translation: **示例**：您在数据表的顶部或底部添加图例，用以说明列的含义、单位、异常情况等。

fdfce8f9f31f8e5f6ca0a3c282a10de938b50eb4.source: **Solution**: Recording data about your data ("metadata") is essential. You may be on intimate terms with your dataset while you are collecting and analysing it, but the chances that you will still remember that the variable "sglmemgp" means single member of group, for example, or the exact algorithm you used to transform a variable or create a derived one, after a few months, a year, or more are slim.
fdfce8f9f31f8e5f6ca0a3c282a10de938b50eb4.translation: **解决方案**：记录数据相关信息（“元数据”）至关重要。在收集和分析数据集时，你可能对其了如指掌，但几个月、一年或更长时间后，你能否还记得例如变量“sglmemgp”代表“组中的单个成员”，或者你用于转换变量或创建衍生变量时使用的具体算法，可能性很小。

18ab3cd20ec550e3ce6e396dcbb3356c4f123218.source: As well, there are many reasons other people may want to examine or use your data - to understand your findings, to verify your findings, to review your submitted publication, to replicate your results, to design a similar study, or even to archive your data for access and re-use by others. While digital data by definition are machine-readable, understanding their meaning is a job for human beings. The importance of documenting your data during the collection and analysis phase of your research cannot be overestimated, especially if your research is going to be part of the scholarly record.
18ab3cd20ec550e3ce6e396dcbb3356c4f123218.translation: 此外，他人可能出于多种原因希望检查或使用您的数据——例如为了理解您的研究结果、验证您的研究结果、审阅您提交的出版物、复现您的结果、设计类似的研究，甚至是为了存档您的数据以便他人访问和重复使用。虽然数字数据在定义上是机器可读的，但理解其含义则是人类的工作。在研究的收集和分析阶段记录数据的重要性无论如何强调都不为过，尤其是当您的研究将成为学术记录的一部分时。

ba67065a53b2d23b66031b35444867f1171ca681.source: However, metadata should not be contained in the data file itself. Unlike a table in a paper or a supplemental file, metadata (in the form of legends) should not be included in a data file since this information is not data, and including it can disrupt how computer programs interpret your data file. Rather, metadata should be stored as a separate file in the same directory as your data file, preferably in plain text format with a name that clearly associates it with your data file. Because metadata files are free text format, they also allow you to encode comments, units, information about how null values are encoded, etc. that are important to document but can disrupt the formatting of your data file.
ba67065a53b2d23b66031b35444867f1171ca681.translation: 然而，元数据不应包含在数据文件本身中。与论文中的表格或补充文件不同，元数据（以图例形式呈现）不应包含在数据文件中，因为此类信息并非数据，且将其包含在内可能会干扰计算机程序对数据文件的解析。相反，元数据应作为独立文件存储在与数据文件相同的目录下，最好采用纯文本格式，并使用能清晰地将其与数据文件关联的文件名。由于元数据文件采用纯文本格式，您还可以在其中编码注释、单位、关于缺失值如何编码的信息等，这些内容对于记录至关重要，但可能会干扰数据文件的格式。

b8158070ef5bab6bb0a56ef00f90dbddfaeca5d8.source: Additionally, file or database level metadata describes how files that make up the dataset relate to each other; what format they are in; and whether they supercede or are superceded by previous files. A folder-level readme.txt file is the classic way of accounting for all the files and folders in a project.
b8158070ef5bab6bb0a56ef00f90dbddfaeca5d8.translation: 此外，文件或数据库级别的元数据描述了构成数据集的文件之间如何关联；它们采用何种格式；以及它们是取代之前的文件，还是被之前的文件取代。文件夹级别的 readme.txt 文件是记录项目中所有文件和文件夹的经典方式。

dff4a5828ef87ce9b979a08d3cd8ce67586d1690.source: (Text on metadata adapted from the online course Research Data [MANTRA](<x0/>) by EDINA and Data Library, University of Edinburgh. MANTRA is licensed under a [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](<x1/>).)
dff4a5828ef87ce9b979a08d3cd8ce67586d1690.translation: （关于元数据的文字改编自爱丁堡大学 EDINA 和数据库提供的在线课程 Research Data [MANTRA](<x0/>)。MANTRA 采用 [知识共享 署名 4.0 国际许可协议](<x1/>) 授权。）

5c71d2f1c4f6f14e7e3a0c48becf3cd0f84b31d5.source: How can we export data from spreadsheets in a way that is useful for downstream applications?
5c71d2f1c4f6f14e7e3a0c48becf3cd0f84b31d5.translation: 我们如何将电子表格中的数据导出，以便于后续应用？

f93bd36900a344b4ec4331da1149188066dc1fd8.source: Store spreadsheet data in universal file formats.
f93bd36900a344b4ec4331da1149188066dc1fd8.translation: 将电子表格数据存储为通用文件格式。

ef85b0157b2adb826de05adc57d6921b08e9fbd4.source: Export data from a spreadsheet to a CSV file.
ef85b0157b2adb826de05adc57d6921b08e9fbd4.translation: 将数据从电子表格导出为 CSV 文件。

fb47cdfad800ef37a8bf10fde1d780d5d97382f4.source: Data stored in common spreadsheet formats will often not be read correctly into data analysis software, introducing errors into your data.
fb47cdfad800ef37a8bf10fde1d780d5d97382f4.translation: 存储在常用电子表格格式中的数据通常无法被数据分析软件正确读取，从而导致数据出现错误。

c211154ee498a7f37056f91f0d23f52264def2ce.source: Exporting data from spreadsheets to formats like CSV or TSV puts it in a format that can be used consistently by most programs.
c211154ee498a7f37056f91f0d23f52264def2ce.translation: 将数据从电子表格导出为 CSV 或 TSV 等格式，可使其成为大多数程序都能一致使用的格式。

e31c067830a6c5047c8a2fece53770afdcd14cef.source: Storing the data you're going to work with for your analyses in Excel default file format (<x0/> or <x1/> - depending on the Excel version) isn't a good idea. Why?
e31c067830a6c5047c8a2fece53770afdcd14cef.translation: 将待分析的数据以 Excel 默认文件格式（<x0/> 或 <x1/> —— 取决于 Excel 版本）存储，并非良策。为什么？

6d813b3e5a02464c24df3789e846709d52ed6ad1.source: Because it is a proprietary format, and it is possible that in the future, technology won't exist (or will become sufficiently rare) to make it inconvenient, if not impossible, to open the file.
6d813b3e5a02464c24df3789e846709d52ed6ad1.translation: 因为这是一种专有格式，且未来可能不再有用于打开该文件的技术（或该技术将变得十分罕见），从而导致文件难以打开，甚至无法打开。

cb84962572720ed4ee19d30f57cf589029e33915.source: Other spreadsheet software may not be able to open files saved in a proprietary Excel format.
cb84962572720ed4ee19d30f57cf589029e33915.translation: 其他电子表格软件可能无法打开以专有 Excel 格式保存的文件。

c3b016e50bf78c6f5c8f4c4277efbfdd610ca10d.source: Different versions of Excel may handle data differently, leading to inconsistencies. [Dates](<x0/>) is a well-documented example of inconsistencies in data storage.
c3b016e50bf78c6f5c8f4c4277efbfdd610ca10d.translation: 不同版本的 Excel 处理数据的方式可能有所不同，从而导致不一致。[日期](<x0/>) 是一个关于数据存储不一致的典型案例，相关资料已十分详尽。

f4bdeacbd93556b578ea511b57fd1184dcb3fd53.source: Finally, more journals and grant agencies are requiring you to deposit your data in a data repository, and most of them don't accept Excel format. It needs to be in one of the formats discussed below.
f4bdeacbd93556b578ea511b57fd1184dcb3fd53.translation: 最后，越来越多的期刊和资助机构要求您将数据存放在数据存储库中，且其中大多数不接受 Excel 格式。数据需要采用下文讨论的格式之一。

47c2456eed27df7b68c42a3cfd8c77690931b2ee.source: The above points also apply to other formats such as open data formats used by LibreOffice / Open Office. These formats are not static and do not get parsed the same way by different software packages.
47c2456eed27df7b68c42a3cfd8c77690931b2ee.translation: 上述要点同样适用于其他格式，例如 LibreOffice / Open Office 使用的开放数据格式。这些格式并非静态的，且不同软件包对其解析方式各异。

e2f9e402c2c52c6bad37e4e3974b3d18ad2987a1.source: Storing data in a universal, open, and static format will help deal with this problem. Try tab-delimited (tab separated values or TSV) or comma-delimited (comma separated values or CSV). CSV files are plain text files where the columns are separated by commas, hence 'comma separated values' or CSV. The advantage of a CSV file over an Excel/SPSS/etc. file is that we can open and read a CSV file using just about any software, including plain text editors like TextEdit or NotePad. Data in a CSV file can also be easily imported into other formats and environments, such as SQLite and R. We're not tied to a certain version of a certain expensive program when we work with CSV files, so it's a good format to work with for maximum portability and endurance. Most spreadsheet programs can save to delimited text formats like CSV easily, although they may give you a warning during the file export.
e2f9e402c2c52c6bad37e4e3974b3d18ad2987a1.translation: 将数据以通用、开放且静态的格式存储有助于解决这一问题。可以尝试使用制表符分隔（tab-delimited，或称为 TSV）或逗号分隔（comma-delimited，或称为 CSV）格式。CSV 文件是纯文本文件，列之间由逗号分隔，因此被称为“逗号分隔值”或 CSV。与 Excel/SPSS 等文件相比，CSV 文件的优势在于，我们几乎可以使用任何软件（包括 TextEdit 或 NotePad 等纯文本编辑器）来打开并读取 CSV 文件。CSV 文件中的数据也可以轻松导入到其他格式和环境中，例如 SQLite 和 R。在处理 CSV 文件时，我们不必受限于某个昂贵程序的特定版本，因此它是实现最大可移植性和持久性的理想格式。大多数电子表格程序都可以轻松保存为 CSV 等分隔文本格式，尽管在导出文件时可能会弹出警告。

5eabde2d73ff1099987709d5705d3abbfcaf37af.source: To save a file you have opened in Excel in CSV format:
5eabde2d73ff1099987709d5705d3abbfcaf37af.translation: 若要将在 Excel 中打开的文件保存为 CSV 格式：

fb0d5f8fe8accf3c1897d364df4eda9297d29e07.source: From the top menu select 'File' and 'Save as'.
fb0d5f8fe8accf3c1897d364df4eda9297d29e07.translation: 从顶部菜单中选择“文件”和“另存为”。

c414d4b8fba5c9412f53366be5e6dde985ac2e6a.source: In the 'Format' field, from the list, select 'Comma Separated Values' (<x0/>).
c414d4b8fba5c9412f53366be5e6dde985ac2e6a.translation: 在“格式”字段中，从列表中选择“逗号分隔值” (<x0/>)。

30d0847713dcd56292cf99c84d30754a4ec8c681.source: Double check the file name and the location where you want to save it and hit 'Save'.
30d0847713dcd56292cf99c84d30754a4ec8c681.translation: 再次确认文件名和想要保存的位置，然后点击“保存”。

6844163576fa7fa4337b2fdf28a6cf27b9017a40.source: An important note for backwards compatibility: you can open CSV files in Excel!
6844163576fa7fa4337b2fdf28a6cf27b9017a40.translation: 关于向后兼容性的重要提示：您可以使用 Excel 打开 CSV 文件！

a2abe0fe17f408e6c7dbe6ca5ffdb18b7e797ddc.source: **A note on R and <x0/>**: There are R packages that can read <x1/> files (as well as Google spreadsheets). It is even possible to access different worksheets in the <x2/> documents.
a2abe0fe17f408e6c7dbe6ca5ffdb18b7e797ddc.translation: **关于 R 和 <x0/> 的说明**：有一些 R 包可以读取 <x1/> 文件（以及 Google 电子表格）。甚至可以访问 <x2/> 文档中的不同工作表。

40a9a3b7856cbea0c36170266df9265116fdbe70.source: some of these only work on Windows.
40a9a3b7856cbea0c36170266df9265116fdbe70.translation: 其中一些仅在 Windows 上可用。

8674216533bd4537c459dae92ed55d3b871d2394.source: this equates to replacing a (simple but manual) export to <x0/> with additional complexity/dependencies in the data analysis R code.
8674216533bd4537c459dae92ed55d3b871d2394.translation: 这相当于将（简单但手动的）导出为 <x0/> 替换为数据分析 R 代码中额外的复杂性/依赖项。

0c5eddaedd08f815ef6ad67de228178f6d06ec57.source: data formatting best practice still apply.
0c5eddaedd08f815ef6ad67de228178f6d06ec57.translation: 数据格式化的最佳实践依然适用。

f1359e9fe9e707e8a9dd94337e37ef4e512cf072.source: Is there really a good reason why <x0/> (or similar) is not adequate?
f1359e9fe9e707e8a9dd94337e37ef4e512cf072.translation: 真的有充分的理由说 <x0/>（或类似形式）不够用吗？

8e7012ca43647551d5b187076b889e668ff8790b.source: In some datasets, the data values themselves may include commas (,). In that case, the software which you use (including Excel) will most likely incorrectly display the data in columns. This is because the commas which are a part of the data values will be interpreted as delimiters.
8e7012ca43647551d5b187076b889e668ff8790b.translation: 在某些数据集中，数据值本身可能包含逗号 (,)。在这种情况下，您使用的软件（包括 Excel）很可能会错误地将数据以列形式显示。这是因为作为数据值一部分的逗号会被解释为分隔符。

d644e0592ec63f86619c2dd17a626a8873c4b98c.source: For example, our data might look like this:
d644e0592ec63f86619c2dd17a626a8873c4b98c.translation: 例如，我们的数据可能如下所示：

c4ec284d6cfc1afb9ad6799c513f82b25a77c6df.source: In the record <x0/> the value for <x1/> includes a comma (<x2/>).  If we try to read the above into Excel (or other spreadsheet program), we will get something like this:
c4ec284d6cfc1afb9ad6799c513f82b25a77c6df.translation: 在记录 <x0/> 中，<x1/> 的值包含一个逗号 (<x2/>)。如果我们尝试将上述内容导入 Excel（或其他电子表格程序），会得到如下结果：

19e3afe3a63f4a1be4c2ba6f31a8969368863e46.source: The value for <x0/> was split into two columns (instead of being put in one column <x1/>). This can propagate to a number of further errors. For example, the extra column will be interpreted as a column with many missing values (and without a proper header). In addition to that, the value in column <x2/> for the record in row 3 (so the one where the value for 'taxa' contained the comma) is now incorrect.
19e3afe3a63f4a1be4c2ba6f31a8969368863e46.translation: <x0/> 的值被分成了两列（而非放入单一列 <x1/> 中）。这可能会引发一系列进一步的错误。例如，多出来的那一列会被解释为一个包含大量缺失值（且没有正确标题）的列。此外，第 3 行记录（即 'taxa' 的值包含逗号的那一行）中列 <x2/> 的值现在是不正确的。

2edbad6b8ecf56e3f5ca384a0f31cbb2aefc2f29.source: If you want to store your data in <x0/> format and expect that your data values may contain commas, you can avoid the problem discussed above by putting the values in quotes (""). Applying this rule, our data might look like this:
2edbad6b8ecf56e3f5ca384a0f31cbb2aefc2f29.translation: 如果您想以 <x0/> 格式存储数据，且预计数据值中可能包含逗号，可以通过将值放在引号 ("") 中来避免上述问题。按照此规则，我们的数据可能如下所示：

9f9a30e4c7f1cc089fe8d2ec8bb6f7aa107e76b7.source: Now opening this file as a <x0/> in Excel will not lead to an extra column, because Excel will only use commas that fall outside of quotation marks as delimiting characters.
9f9a30e4c7f1cc089fe8d2ec8bb6f7aa107e76b7.translation: 现在将此文件作为 <x0/> 在 Excel 中打开将不会导致出现额外列，因为 Excel 仅将位于引号之外的逗号作为分隔符。

26f621ff0cb0bdfa37a9a44b31cb36fd760fd6cd.source: Alternatively, if you are working with data that contains commas, you likely will need to use another delimiter when working in a spreadsheet<x0/>. In this case, consider using tabs as your delimiter and working with TSV files. TSV files can be exported from spreadsheet programs in the same way as CSV files.
26f621ff0cb0bdfa37a9a44b31cb36fd760fd6cd.translation: 或者，如果您处理的数据包含逗号，在使用电子表格时可能需要使用另一种分隔符<x0/>。在这种情况下，可以考虑使用制表符作为分隔符，并使用 TSV 文件。TSV 文件可以像 CSV 文件一样从电子表格软件导出。

533a812d1f83d14c30b9150eb0969c3922d9aebc.source: This is particularly relevant in European countries where the comma is used as a decimal separator. In such cases, the default value separator in a csv file will be the semi-colon (;), or values will be systematically quoted.
533a812d1f83d14c30b9150eb0969c3922d9aebc.translation: 这在将逗号用作小数点分隔符的欧洲国家尤为重要。在这种情况下，CSV 文件的默认值分隔符将是分号 (;)，或者值将被系统性地加引号。

28d090558d38c4a965806c8fcc18776e3a2521e5.source: If you are working with an already existing dataset in which the data values are not included in "" but which have commas as both delimiters and parts of data values, you are potentially facing a major problem with data cleaning. If the dataset you're dealing with contains hundreds or thousands of records, cleaning them up manually (by either removing commas from the data values or putting the values into quotes - "") is not only going to take hours and hours but may potentially end up with you accidentally introducing many errors.
28d090558d38c4a965806c8fcc18776e3a2521e5.translation: 如果您正在处理一个现有的数据集，其中数据值不包含在 "" 中，但同时使用逗号作为分隔符和数据值的一部分，那么您可能正面临数据清洗方面的重大问题。如果您处理的数据集包含数百或数千条记录，手动清洗（无论是从数据值中删除逗号，还是将值放入引号 - "" 中）不仅会耗费大量时间，还可能导致您不小心引入许多错误。

fca152e5c6eb7be91b73c2d098d6012e12313272.source: Cleaning up datasets is one of the major problems in many scientific disciplines. The approach almost always depends on the particular context. However, it is a good practice to clean the data in an automated fashion, for example by writing and running a script. The Python and R lessons will give you the basis for developing skills to build relevant scripts.
fca152e5c6eb7be91b73c2d098d6012e12313272.translation: 数据集清洗是许多科学领域面临的主要问题之一。其处理方法几乎总是取决于具体情境。不过，采用自动化方式清洗数据是一个良好的实践，例如编写并运行脚本。Python 和 R 课程将为你提供开发相关脚本技能的基础。

67c2fc4525cb2aa7f11f963ab4ae260ce4cd01ea.source: A typical data analysis workflow is illustrated in the figure above, where data is repeatedly transformed, visualised, and modelled. This iteration is repeated multiple times until the data is understood. In many real-life cases, however, most time is spent cleaning up and preparing the data, rather than actually analysing and understanding it.
67c2fc4525cb2aa7f11f963ab4ae260ce4cd01ea.translation: 典型的数据分析工作流程如上图所示，其中数据会经过反复的转换、可视化和建模。这一迭代过程会重复多次，直到数据被充分理解。然而，在许多实际案例中，大部分时间都花在数据的清洗和准备上，而非实际的分析与理解上。

aeeaab55ec724b4e51578fb46cd3f8aefa72ce44.source: An agile data analysis workflow, with several fast iterations of the transform/visualise/model cycle is only feasible if the data is formatted in a predictable way and one can reason about the data without having to look at it and/or fix it.
aeeaab55ec724b4e51578fb46cd3f8aefa72ce44.translation: 一种敏捷的数据分析工作流——即对“转换/可视化/建模”循环进行多次快速迭代——只有在数据格式可预测，且无需查看或修复数据即可对其进行分析时，才是可行的。

45e5adf9fdc8fd31e8f26a52e51daae4c7f7076f.source: Take about 10 minutes to work on this exercise.
45e5adf9fdc8fd31e8f26a52e51daae4c7f7076f.translation: 花大约 10 分钟完成这道练习。

a95bfcb8fe3e5e4f9c963f3231e7ef9d8d5fd96b.source: All the mistakes in the *common mistakes* section below are present in the messy dataset. If the exercise is done during a workshop, ask people what they saw as wrong with the data. As they bring up different points, you can refer to the common mistakes or expand a bit on the point they brought up.
a95bfcb8fe3e5e4f9c963f3231e7ef9d8d5fd96b.translation: 下文“常见错误”部分中的所有错误都存在于该杂乱的数据集中。如果在工作坊期间进行此练习，请询问参与者认为数据有哪些问题。随着他们提出不同的观点，您可以参考“常见错误”部分，或就他们提出的观点进行进一步详细阐述。

792be2b541e77639e4f916d9e9c813bd1807f14a.source: If you get a response where they've fixed the date, you can pause and go to the dates lesson. Or you can say you'll come back to dates at the end.
792be2b541e77639e4f916d9e9c813bd1807f14a.translation: 如果收到的回复显示他们已经修正了日期，你可以暂停并进入日期课程。或者，你可以说最后再讨论日期。

3812aab4d748233d6836373496ab4f89ec83f0e8.source: This lesson is meant to be used as a reference for discussion as learners identify issues with the messy dataset discussed in the previous lesson. Instructors: don't go through this lesson except to refer to responses to the exercise in the previous lesson.
3812aab4d748233d6836373496ab4f89ec83f0e8.translation: 本课程旨在作为讨论参考，以便学习者在识别前一课讨论的杂乱数据集问题时使用。讲师：除参考前一课练习的回答外，请勿讲解本课程。

4e80c49858fce442cc11fe0e61f7a11d3134d814.source: Describe the purpose of the RStudio Script, Console, Environment, and Plots panes.
4e80c49858fce442cc11fe0e61f7a11d3134d814.translation: 描述 RStudio 的脚本、控制台、环境和图表窗格的用途。

54f744d82915edd9372da37d21a9ca2c9296873b.source: Organise files and directories for a set of analyses as an R project, and understand the purpose of the working directory.
54f744d82915edd9372da37d21a9ca2c9296873b.translation: 将一组分析的文件和目录组织成一个 R 项目，并理解工作目录的作用。

886efa1da2cc451880ed9691c9e174134394782b.source: Use the built-in RStudio help interface to search for more information on R functions.
886efa1da2cc451880ed9691c9e174134394782b.translation: 使用 RStudio 内置的帮助界面搜索有关 R 函数的更多信息。

5c24f5f532d0827b215392cfc2193bde27b91aa0.source: Demonstrate how to provide sufficient information for troubleshooting with the R user community.
5c24f5f532d0827b215392cfc2193bde27b91aa0.translation: 演示如何向 R 用户社区提供足够的信息以进行故障排除。

4ecee65afdb4b292028937823b8d90be5af25420.translation: 什么是 R 和 RStudio？

29807df5adcb9236158368dfbdd1beec9bf996f1.source: What is R? What is RStudio?
29807df5adcb9236158368dfbdd1beec9bf996f1.translation: 什么是 R？什么是 RStudio？

a6eca8c63f87144d39340be670eadaa20a41e550.source: The term [R](<x0/>) is used to refer to the *programming language*, the *environment for statistical computing* and *the software* that interprets the scripts written using it.
a6eca8c63f87144d39340be670eadaa20a41e550.translation: [R](<x0/>) 一词用于指代*编程语言*、*统计计算环境*以及解释使用该语言编写的脚本的*软件*。

e6039f1279ac4dca0e6818705e18ec577e92ff59.source: [RStudio](<x0/>) is currently a very popular way to not only write your R scripts but also to interact with the R software<x1/>. To function correctly, RStudio needs R and therefore both need to be installed on your computer.
e6039f1279ac4dca0e6818705e18ec577e92ff59.translation: [RStudio](<x0/>) 目前是一种非常流行的方式，不仅可以用来编写 R 脚本，还能用于与 R 软件进行交互<x1/>。为了正常运行，RStudio 需要 R，因此两者都必须安装在您的计算机上。

615f3826dc07a0772a20bd7d491d37eb59aa143c.source: As opposed to using R directly from the command line console. There exist other software that interface and integrate with R, but RStudio is particularly well suited for beginners while providing numerous very advanced features.
615f3826dc07a0772a20bd7d491d37eb59aa143c.translation: 与直接在命令行控制台使用 R 不同。虽然还有其他能与 R 对接并集成的软件，但 RStudio 特别适合初学者，同时还提供了许多非常高级的功能。

e0c82aeff1bad5d1b39db8c44e8705383802b47e.source: The [RStudio IDE Cheat Sheet](<x0/>) provides much more information than will be covered here, but can be useful to learn keyboard shortcuts and discover new features.
e0c82aeff1bad5d1b39db8c44e8705383802b47e.translation: [RStudio IDE 快捷键表](<x0/>) 提供的信息远比本文所涵盖的要多，但对于学习键盘快捷键和探索新功能非常有帮助。

89a66ff92fff450d72ac6665e9cea4d02d9fcffe.source: R does not involve lots of pointing and clicking, and that's a good thing
89a66ff92fff450d72ac6665e9cea4d02d9fcffe.translation: R 不需要频繁地点击操作，而这正是其优势所在。

6e9a5f1aa0db110528d01e0d9be009e6fe121443.source: The learning curve might be steeper than with other software, but with R, the results of your analysis do not rely on remembering a succession of pointing and clicking, but instead on a series of written commands, and that's a good thing! So, if you want to redo your analysis because you collected more data, you don't have to remember which button you clicked in which order to obtain your results; you just have to run your script again.
6e9a5f1aa0db110528d01e0d9be009e6fe121443.translation: 学习曲线可能比其他软件更陡峭，但使用 R 时，分析结果并不依赖于记忆一连串的点击操作，而是基于一系列书面命令，而这正是其优势所在！因此，如果你因为收集了更多数据而想要重新进行分析，你不需要记住按哪个按钮、按什么顺序才能获得结果；你只需再次运行你的脚本即可。

6807f173a7c82f5b732e37e18f98ef98ea6220b1.source: Working with scripts makes the steps you used in your analysis clear, and the code you write can be inspected by someone else who can give you feedback and spot mistakes.
6807f173a7c82f5b732e37e18f98ef98ea6220b1.translation: 使用脚本可以让分析过程中采取的步骤清晰可见，而且你编写的代码可以由他人检查，从而获得反馈并发现错误。

2b349b67bfb3ad25136db88854f0b825ec1afa40.source: Working with scripts forces you to have a deeper understanding of what you are doing, and facilitates your learning and comprehension of the methods you use.
2b349b67bfb3ad25136db88854f0b825ec1afa40.translation: 使用脚本会迫使你对所做的工作有更深入的理解，并有助于你学习和掌握所使用的方法。

244178a841c133c3412af6d3fdb2b1b2e5d413e8.source: R code is great for reproducibility
244178a841c133c3412af6d3fdb2b1b2e5d413e8.translation: R 代码有助于实现可复现性

ef192a1a5c2d74b086eeb77f1a9c4eceabbf9239.source: Reproducibility means that someone else (including your future self) can obtain the same results from the same dataset when using the same analysis code.
ef192a1a5c2d74b086eeb77f1a9c4eceabbf9239.translation: 可复现性意味着其他人（包括未来的你自己）在使用相同的分析代码时，能够从同一数据集获得相同的结果。

9ab42c0bfbc2239441017540017f67c114f594f8.source: R integrates with other tools to generate manuscripts or reports from your code. If you collect more data, or fix a mistake in your dataset, the figures and the statistical tests in your manuscript or report are updated automatically.
9ab42c0bfbc2239441017540017f67c114f594f8.translation: R 可与其他工具集成，从您的代码中生成论文或报告。如果您收集了更多数据，或修正了数据集中的错误，论文或报告中的图表和统计检验将自动更新。

1e334511ede90b61302dd538ed1282d4d6affdfb.source: An increasing number of journals and funding agencies expect analyses to be reproducible, so knowing R will give you an edge with these requirements.
1e334511ede90b61302dd538ed1282d4d6affdfb.translation: 越来越多的期刊和资助机构要求分析结果具有可复现性，因此掌握 R 将使你在满足这些要求时占据优势。

84b0f3f71374820b754e914087a4cb8e5a3d8bd1.translation: R 具有跨学科性和可扩展性

cea5e113ada9536a435a596c6405ff09c5728371.source: With 10000+ packages<x0/> that can be installed to extend its capabilities, R provides a framework that allows you to combine statistical approaches from many scientific disciplines to best suit the analytical framework you need to analyse your data. For instance, R has packages for image analysis, GIS, time series, population genetics, and a lot more.
cea5e113ada9536a435a596c6405ff09c5728371.translation: R 提供了一个框架，允许你安装 10,000 多个<x0/> 包来扩展其功能，从而将许多科学领域的统计方法相结合，以最好地适配你分析数据所需的分析框架。例如，R 拥有用于图像分析、GIS、时间序列、群体遗传学等诸多领域的包。

3fcae566dc9a6e747d81ba74f2658a65e427039c.source: i.e. add-ons that confer R with new functionality, such as bioinformatics data analysis.
3fcae566dc9a6e747d81ba74f2658a65e427039c.translation: 即赋予 R 新功能的附加组件，例如生物信息学数据分析。

74597bc5b375922490859c85cafb5d69f9419ac9.source: R works on data of all shapes and sizes
74597bc5b375922490859c85cafb5d69f9419ac9.translation: R 适用于各种形状和规模的数据

094230c9e8861cf77a443c828207d9b45a6bda1e.source: The skills you learn with R scale easily with the size of your dataset. Whether your dataset has hundreds or millions of lines, it won't make much difference to you.
094230c9e8861cf77a443c828207d9b45a6bda1e.translation: 您通过 R 学习的技能可以轻松适配数据集的规模。无论您的数据集包含数百行还是数百万行，对您来说都没有太大影响。

3ad7b4bacf2111ec4fecc48c1c8597e36dc1f46e.source: R is designed for data analysis. It comes with special data structures and data types that make handling of missing data and statistical factors convenient.
3ad7b4bacf2111ec4fecc48c1c8597e36dc1f46e.translation: R 专为数据分析而设计。它配备了特殊的数据结构和数据类型，使缺失数据和统计因子的处理变得十分便捷。

9e320bbfb9e6fc2a995b989638c4ec0078b9a817.source: R can connect to spreadsheets, databases, and many other data formats, on your computer or on the web.
9e320bbfb9e6fc2a995b989638c4ec0078b9a817.translation: R 可以连接到电脑上或网络上的电子表格、数据库以及许多其他数据格式。

da44dde4dff080d067605ce483a8ffb9d86bb5f1.translation: R 能生成高质量的图表

c5a8b17e366c5a9af9069701db2803f60077c791.source: The plotting functionalities in R are extensive, and allow you to adjust any aspect of your graph to convey most effectively the message from your data.
c5a8b17e366c5a9af9069701db2803f60077c791.translation: R 的绘图功能非常丰富，允许您调整图表的任何方面，以最有效地传达数据所包含的信息。

5012f095443388f446888837839b4613bb90e9ce.source: R has a large and welcoming community
5012f095443388f446888837839b4613bb90e9ce.translation: R 拥有一个规模庞大且热情友好的社区

d08daff52eabd60d0cbfa6db5c36ec570bac0e97.source: Thousands of people use R daily. Many of them are willing to help you through mailing lists and websites such as [Stack Overflow](<x0/>), or on the [RStudio community](<x1/>). These broad user communities extend to specialised areas such as bioinformatics. One such subset of the R community is [Bioconductor](<x2/>), a scientific project for analysis and comprehension "of data from current and emerging biological assays." This workshop was developed by members of the Bioconductor community; for more information on Bioconductor, please see the companion workshop ["The Bioconductor Project"](<x3/>).
d08daff52eabd60d0cbfa6db5c36ec570bac0e97.translation: 每天有数以千计的人使用 R。其中许多人愿意通过邮件列表和 [Stack Overflow](<x0/>) 等网站，或在 [RStudio 社区](<x1/>) 为你提供帮助。这些广泛的用户社区延伸至生物信息学等专业领域。R 社区的一个子集是 [Bioconductor](<x2/>)，这是一个旨在分析和理解“当前及新兴生物测定数据”的科学项目。本工作坊由 Bioconductor 社区成员开发；如需了解更多关于 Bioconductor 的信息，请参阅配套工作坊 [“Bioconductor 项目”](<x3/>)。

3e9f03432daa3fe1451e7b815c050dc1b22c4855.source: Not only is R free, but it is also open-source and cross-platform
3e9f03432daa3fe1451e7b815c050dc1b22c4855.translation: R 不仅免费，而且还是开源且跨平台的

d744c23b3b9dd8a5ba5e4dffb5247fc937963d33.source: Anyone can inspect the source code to see how R works. Because of this transparency, there is less chance for mistakes, and if you (or someone else) find some, you can report and fix bugs.
d744c23b3b9dd8a5ba5e4dffb5247fc937963d33.translation: 任何人都可以查看源代码，以了解 R 的工作原理。得益于这种透明度，出错的可能性较低，而且如果你（或他人）发现了错误，可以报告并修复 Bug。

636a3549cbecd22759bd40cf32f04b1bd8aeadd8.source: Let's start by learning about [RStudio](<x0/>), which is an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) for working with R.
636a3549cbecd22759bd40cf32f04b1bd8aeadd8.translation: 让我们先来了解一下 [RStudio](<x0/>)，这是一个用于操作 R 的集成开发环境 (IDE)。

5658d1fa62a908e373fe5123f9f9237e43e93b58.source: The RStudio IDE open-source product is free under the [Affero General Public License (AGPL) v3](<x0/>). The RStudio IDE is also available with a commercial license and priority email support from Posit, Inc.
5658d1fa62a908e373fe5123f9f9237e43e93b58.translation: RStudio IDE 这一开源产品根据 [Affero 通用公共许可证 (AGPL) v3](<x0/>) 免费提供。RStudio IDE 也提供商业许可证，并可获得 Posit, Inc. 的优先电子邮件支持。

288e13a7c66b280cf49035d4e77f1a3be9c02473.source: We will use the RStudio IDE to write code, navigate the files on our computer, inspect the variables we are going to create, and visualise the plots we will generate. RStudio can also be used for other things (e.g., version control, developing packages, writing Shiny apps) that we will not cover during the workshop.
288e13a7c66b280cf49035d4e77f1a3be9c02473.translation: 我们将使用 RStudio IDE 编写代码、浏览计算机上的文件、检查即将创建的变量，以及可视化将生成的图表。RStudio 还可用于其他用途（例如版本控制、开发软件包、编写 Shiny 应用），但这些内容在本次工作坊中将不予涵盖。

b1ebba023ae55d8170e21c352d325d36def5c4fa.source: The RStudio window is divided into 4 "Panes":
b1ebba023ae55d8170e21c352d325d36def5c4fa.translation: RStudio 窗口分为 4 个“窗格”：

b9e8d97809774a71713b47c2086e40166458c7a2.source: the **Source** for your scripts and documents (top-left, in the default layout)
b9e8d97809774a71713b47c2086e40166458c7a2.translation: 用于脚本和文档的 **Source**（左上角，默认布局）

fbcdb906f82d2ed266b7adfa41b588c511e13994.translation: 您的 **环境/历史记录**（右上角），

432dd64ee205a05f841ec4e1329a3214e82dca48.translation: 您的 **文件/图表/包/帮助/查看器**（右下角），以及

b25f47ec0f7454545375cbb907f8542fb16f6f52.source: The placement of these panes and their content can be customised (see menu, <x0/>).
b25f47ec0f7454545375cbb907f8542fb16f6f52.translation: 这些窗格的布局及其内容均可自定义（参见菜单，<x0/>）。

ce96918aa937ea0ffd8747881f751c986a6d7a52.source: One of the advantages of using RStudio is that all the information you need to write code is available in a single window. Additionally, with many shortcuts, **autocompletion**, and **highlighting** for the major file types you use while developing in R, RStudio will make typing easier and less error-prone.
ce96918aa937ea0ffd8747881f751c986a6d7a52.translation: 使用 RStudio 的优势之一是，编写代码所需的所有信息都集中在单个窗口中。此外，凭借大量快捷键、**自动补全**以及在 R 开发过程中常用的主要文件类型的**高亮显示**，RStudio 将使输入更加便捷，且更不易出错。

d788a64524ebd157b3a59c356f7c58b378f2ffe5.source: It is good practice to keep a set of related data, analyses, and text self-contained in a single folder, called the **working directory**. All of the scripts within this folder can then use **relative paths** to files that indicate where inside the project a file is located (as opposed to absolute paths, which point to where a file is on a specific computer). Working this way makes it a lot easier to move your project around on your computer and share it with others without worrying about whether or not the underlying scripts will still work.
d788a64524ebd157b3a59c356f7c58b378f2ffe5.translation: 将一组相关的数据、分析和文本整合在同一个文件夹中，即所谓的**工作目录**，是一个良好的实践。这样，该文件夹内的所有脚本都可以使用**相对路径**来指定文件在项目中的位置（而非绝对路径，后者指向文件在特定计算机上的具体位置）。采用这种方式，在计算机上移动项目并与他人共享时，无需担心底层脚本是否仍能正常运行，会变得容易得多。

6c89625be529d3a8b20aa78a16319822e7369f2c.source: RStudio provides a helpful set of tools to do this through its "Projects" interface, which not only creates a working directory for you, but also remembers its location (allowing you to quickly navigate to it) and optionally preserves custom settings and open files to make it easier to resume work after a break. Go through the steps for creating an "R Project" for this tutorial below.
6c89625be529d3a8b20aa78a16319822e7369f2c.translation: RStudio 通过其“项目”界面提供了一套实用的工具来实现这一点。该界面不仅能为您创建工作目录，还能记住其位置（方便您快速导航），并可选择保留自定义设置和打开的文件，以便在休息后更轻松地恢复工作。请按照以下步骤为本教程创建“R 项目”。

7d8d679b6d2463b24f164bf931d7dbd1f2e25bd0.source: Under the <x0/> menu, click on <x1/>. Choose <x2/>, then <x3/>.
7d8d679b6d2463b24f164bf931d7dbd1f2e25bd0.translation: 在 <x0/> 菜单下，点击 <x1/>。选择 <x2/>，然后选择 <x3/>。

9fa774cc89ed716edaf2e2f62cbef8bfe2db0e98.source: Enter a name for this new folder (or "directory"), and choose a convenient location for it. This will be your **working directory** for this session (or whole course) (e.g., <x0/>).
9fa774cc89ed716edaf2e2f62cbef8bfe2db0e98.translation: 为此新文件夹（或“目录”）输入名称，并选择一个方便的位置。这将成为您本次会话（或整个课程）的**工作目录**（例如，<x0/>）。

1fe7c66384f026a6583076b390d9de333c17f0bc.source: (Optional) Set Preferences to 'Never' save workspace in RStudio.
1fe7c66384f026a6583076b390d9de333c17f0bc.translation: （可选）将偏好设置为“从不”在 RStudio 中保存工作区。

2808cf78bc4a211d9770f5cb4196c92419751d55.source: RStudio's default preferences generally work well, but saving a workspace to .RData can be cumbersome, especially if you are working with larger datasets. To turn that off, go to Tools --> 'Global Options' and select the 'Never' option for 'Save workspace to .RData' on exit.
2808cf78bc4a211d9770f5cb4196c92419751d55.translation: RStudio 的默认设置通常效果良好，但将工作区保存为 .RData 可能会很繁琐，尤其是当你处理较大的数据集时。若要关闭此功能，请前往“工具” --> “全局选项”，并在“退出时将工作区保存为 .RData”处选择“从不”选项。

0c9b87fe28a1b5346b3140398a033d3c872bf992.source: To avoid [character encoding issues between Windows and other operating systems](<x0/>), we are going to set UTF-8 by default:
0c9b87fe28a1b5346b3140398a033d3c872bf992.translation: 为了避免[Windows 与其他操作系统之间的字符编码问题](<x0/>)，我们将默认设置为 UTF-8：

8d79e00416bc4ff4fc43b35b8f713d908e90f9c4.source: Using a consistent folder structure across your projects will help keep things organised, and will also make it easy to find/file things in the future. This can be especially helpful when you have multiple projects. In general, you may create directories (folders) for **scripts**, **data**, and **documents**.
8d79e00416bc4ff4fc43b35b8f713d908e90f9c4.translation: 在各个项目中使用统一的文件夹结构有助于保持有序，并方便日后查找和归档。当您拥有多个项目时，这一点尤为有用。通常情况下，您可以为 **脚本**、**数据** 和 **文档** 分别创建目录（文件夹）。

88e76ef7443821be9cc2669f6903e4741b435f89.source: **<x0/>** Use this folder to store your raw data and intermediate datasets you may create for the need of a particular analysis. For the sake of transparency and [provenance](<x1/>), you should *always* keep a copy of your raw data accessible and do as much of your data cleanup and preprocessing programmatically (i.e., with scripts, rather than manually) as possible. Separating raw data from processed data is also a good idea. For example, you could have files <x2/> and <x3/> kept separate from a <x4/> file generated by the <x5/> script.
88e76ef7443821be9cc2669f6903e4741b435f89.translation: **<x0/>** 使用此文件夹存储原始数据以及您为特定分析而创建的中间数据集。为了确保透明度和[来源可追溯性](<x1/>)，您*应始终*保留一份可访问的原始数据副本，并尽可能通过编程方式（即使用脚本，而非手动操作）完成数据清洗和预处理。将原始数据与处理后的数据分开也是一个好主意。例如，您可以将文件 <x2/> 和 <x3/> 与由 <x5/> 脚本生成的 <x4/> 文件分开存放。

d96f820991d14abed3ba6cdef8a2ecfcdad53b19.source: **<x0/>** This would be a place to keep outlines, drafts, and other text.
d96f820991d14abed3ba6cdef8a2ecfcdad53b19.translation: **<x0/>** 这里用于存放大纲、草稿和其他文本。

bd014a70ca00b08ca94d11e2a06c578626cdb9a9.source: **<x0/>** (or <x1/>) This would be the location to keep your R scripts for different analyses or plotting, and potentially a separate folder for your functions (more on that later).
bd014a70ca00b08ca94d11e2a06c578626cdb9a9.translation: **<x0/>**（或 <x1/>）这里将用于存放用于不同分析或绘图的 R 脚本，并可能设有一个用于存放函数的独立文件夹（稍后详述）。

612bb609286f6084165668a41fa76160837ecc21.source: You may want additional directories or subdirectories depending on your project needs, but these should form the backbone of your working directory.
612bb609286f6084165668a41fa76160837ecc21.translation: 根据项目需求，您可能需要额外的目录或子目录，但这些应当构成工作目录的骨架。

0fad7f0752952bcc0be9df1095e65ee5c807852c.source: For this course, we will need a <x0/> folder to store our raw data, and we will use <x1/> for when we learn how to export data as CSV files, and <x2/> folder for the figures that we will save.
0fad7f0752952bcc0be9df1095e65ee5c807852c.translation: 在本课程中，我们需要一个 <x0/> 文件夹来存储原始数据，在学习如何将数据导出为 CSV 文件时将使用 <x1/>，而将使用 <x2/> 文件夹来保存图表。

a9d654b5d2f111e6e57febe70914d9381a7f28a7.source: Challenge: create your project directory structure
a9d654b5d2f111e6e57febe70914d9381a7f28a7.translation: 挑战：创建项目目录结构

(Alternatively, type <x4/> at your R console.) Repeat these operations to create a <x5/> and a <x6/> folders.

e9c416ac8df0a2e36c6583ac16558de1f7b75ee6.source: We are going to keep the script in the root of our working directory because we are only going to use one file and it will make things easier.
e9c416ac8df0a2e36c6583ac16558de1f7b75ee6.translation: 我们将把脚本放在工作目录的根目录下，因为我们只会使用一个文件，这样会更方便。

0474b36ce95581d048ea5ff9ae95b707316b6064.translation: 目录名称采用大号字体，文件名采用小号字体。此处仅显示部分文件。请注意，日期格式为 <x0/>，以便按时间顺序排序。源代码 <x1/> 经过编译生成 <x2/>，并在 <x3/> 中提供文档。数据目录中的 <x4/> 文件指定了谁在何时从哪个 URL 下载了数据文件。驱动脚本 <x5/> 会自动生成三个子目录 split1、split2 和 split3，分别对应三组交叉验证划分。<x6/> 脚本由两个 <x7/> 驱动脚本共同调用。

5ef24e9eb2e0f99286ee737c7111059c406192b3.source: The most important aspect of a well defined and well documented project directory is to enable someone unfamiliar with the project<x0/> to
5ef24e9eb2e0f99286ee737c7111059c406192b3.translation: 一个定义明确且文档详尽的项目目录，其最重要的方面在于能够让不熟悉该项目的人<x0/>

833168210c36df96c95e08dcecdad64f3bb22797.source: understand what the project is about, what data are available, what analyses were run, and what results were produced and, most importantly to
833168210c36df96c95e08dcecdad64f3bb22797.translation: 了解该项目的内容、有哪些可用数据、运行了哪些分析以及产生了哪些结果，而最重要的是，
